'''Maamar Bettayeb''' (born 7 June 1953) is an Algerian [[Control theory|control theorist]], educator and inventor. He is the author of publications on understanding the [[singular value decomposition]] and [[model order reduction]].{{Citation needed|date=March 2021}} Bettayeb is also a promoter of scientific research.<ref>{{Cite web|title=VICE CHANCELLOR FOR RESEARCH AND GRADUATE STUDIES|url=https://www.sharjah.ac.ae/en/about/Senior-Admin/VCRGS/Pages/Bio.aspx|access-date=June 2, 2021|website=www.sharjah.ac.ae}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Resume|url=https://www.sharjah.ac.ae/en/academics/Colleges/eng/dept/ecep/Documents/CVs/M_Bettayeb.pdf|access-date=June 2, 2021|website=www.sharjah.ac.ae}}</ref>

==Early years==
Bettayeb continued his elementary and middle studies in [[Beni Amrane]] before joining the polyvalent high school of [[Tizi Ouzou]] in 1969 to follow his secondary studies in the [[Mathematics]] sector. After obtaining his baccalaureate in 1972 with a first class honors, he obtained a scholarship from the Algerian state to continue his university studies in the United States at the [[University of Southern California]] in [[Los Angeles]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://icerega.utbm.fr/plenary-and-opening/|title=Plenary and Opening {{pipe}} ICEREGA 2020 {{pipe}} ICEREGA 2020 (UTBM)|website=icerega.utbm.fr|date=28 February 2016 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ummto.dz/news/webinaire-automatic-control-state-of-the-art-and-future-directions/|title=Webinaire :Automatic Control: State of the Art and Future Directions -|website=www.ummto.dz}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Maamar Bettayeb|url=https://ae.linkedin.com/in/maamarbettayeb|access-date=June 2, 2021|website=ae.linkedin.com}}</ref>

He obtained his bachelor's degree in [[automatic control]] in 1976, then his master's degree in 1978.<ref>{{Cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=_N5SAAAAMAAJ&q=Bettayeb|title=Applied digital control|date=1985|publisher=North-Holland|others=S. G. Tzafestas|isbn=0-444-87882-3|location=Amsterdam|oclc=12695390}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=SjYBCAAAQBAJ&pg=PA469|title=Rational approximation in systems engineering|date=1983|others=Adhemar Bultheel, P. Dewilde|isbn=978-1-4899-6790-9|location=Boston|oclc=883381015}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=dblp: Maamar Bettayeb|url=https://dblp.org/pid/67/7108|access-date=June 2, 2021|website=dblp.org}}</ref>

Bettayeb obtained his PhD degree in 1981 following his defense of his thesis at the [[University of Southern California]] in the Department of [[Electrical Engineering]], and whose title was "Approximation of Linear Systems: New Approaches Based on Singular Value Decomposition", under the supervision of Professor Emeritus Leonard M. Silverman.<ref>{{Cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=-aN6T0NRYcIC&pg=PA564|title=Digital and numeric techniques and their applications in control systems Part 2 of 2|date=1993|publisher=Academic Press, Inc|others=Cornelius T. Leondes|isbn=978-0-323-16327-9|location=San Diego|oclc=834586473}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=cp4zAQAAIAAJ&q=Bettayeb|title=American Doctoral Dissertations|date=1981|publisher=University Microfilms|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book|last=IEEE Control Systems Society Staff|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=OjhGAQAAIAAJ&q=Bettayeb|title=American Control Conference, 1993.|date=May 1993|publisher=IEEE|others=Inc. Staff Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers|isbn=978-0-7803-0860-2|location=Piscataway|oclc=812642743}}</ref>

==Career==
He worked as a research scientist for a year in [[Houston, Texas]] until 1982 in the Bellaire Research Center at [[Shell Oil Company|Shell Oil Development Company]], in the development of seismic signal processing deconvolution algorithms for the purpose of Gas and Oil exploration. Back in Algeria, he was recruited by the Center for Development of Advanced Technologies (CDTA) where he headed the instrumentation and control department from 1982 until 1988, and he led various [[research and development]] projects in the field of modeling, simulation, and control design of large scale energy systems with applications to nuclear, solar, wind and [[electric power system]]s.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2021-02-11|title=Center for Development of Advanced Technologies – Research, Technology and Society|url=https://www.cdta.dz/|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210211031904/https://www.cdta.dz/|archive-date=February 11, 2021|access-date=2021-06-02|website=www.cdta.dz}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.infona.pl/search/simple?searchPhrase=Maamar+Bettayeb&searchConf=all&localeQueryString=searchPhrase%3DMaamar%2BBettayeb|title=Search results|website=www.infona.pl}}</ref>

He then emigrated to Saudi Arabia where he joined [[King Fahd University of Petroleum and Minerals]] in [[Dhahran]] where he worked for two years until 1990.<ref>{{Cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=cAFTAAAAMAAJ&q=Bettayeb|title=SVD and signal processing, II : algorithms, analysis, and applications|date=1991|publisher=Elsevier|others=Richard J. Vaccaro, University of Rhode Island. College of Engineering, International Workshop on SVD and Signal Processing|isbn=0-444-88896-9|location=Amsterdam|oclc=22911621}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.tandfonline.com/action/doSearch?AllField=Maamar+Bettayeb|title=Search results {{pipe}} Taylor & Francis Online|website=www.tandfonline.com}}</ref>

During the year 2000 he joined the staff of the [[University of Sharjah]] as a professor, where he held research and administrative positions.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.pubfacts.com/author/Maamar+Bettayeb|title=Maamar Bettayeb|website=PubFacts}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://link.springer.com/search?query=Maamar+Bettayeb|title=Search Results - Springer|website=link.springer.com}}</ref>

Since September 2014, Bettayeb has been vice-rector at this university where he is in charge of graduation and research.{{Citation needed|date=March 2021}} He is also associate professor in [[automatic control]] and [[signal processing]] within the Center of Excellence in Intelligent Engineering Systems (CEIES) at [[King Abdulaziz University]] in a research laboratory.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Maamar Bettayeb's research while affiliated with King Abdulaziz University and other places|url=https://www.researchgate.net/scientific-contributions/Maamar-Bettayeb-2157419631|access-date=June 2, 2021|website=www.researchgate.net}}</ref>

During his career, he published more than 350 scientific journal and conference papers.<ref>{{Cite web|last=|first=|title=Distinguished Scientists - Maamar Bettayeb|url=https://dsc.kau.edu.sa/Content-302015-EN-248868|access-date=2021-06-02|website=dsc.kau.edu.sa|language=EN}}</ref>

Bettayeb was an External Examiner for [[Electrical Engineering]] Programs at the [[University of Malaya]] in Malaysia from 2001 to 2004.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Nacima|first=Maidi|date=2020-12-21|title=Webinaire :Automatic Control: State of the Art and Future Directions|url=http://fgei.ummto.dz/index.php/2020/12/21/webinaire-automatic-control-state-of-the-art-and-future-directions/|access-date=2021-06-02|website=Faculté de Génie Electrique et Informatique|language=fr-FR}}</ref>

He also participated as a visiting professor at the [[Helsinki University of Technology]] in Finland during the years 2001 to 2003, where he gave short courses, research seminars, workshops and participated in the examination of doctoral students.{{cn|reason='http://citeseerx.ist.psu.edu/messages/downloadsexceeded.html' isn't a reliable source|date=September 2023}}

Bettayeb has worked in scientific consulting for the petrochemical industries on behalf of several companies, and has also taken part in several R&D funded projects in the fields of control and signal processing applications.<ref name="auto1">{{Cite journal|last1=Shah|first1=S.Faisal A.|last2=Bettayeb|first2=M.|date=January 2007|title=Harmonic Signals in Multiplicative Noise: Estimation Using Genetic Algorithms|url=https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/pdf/10.1080/10798587.2007.10642974 |journal=Intelligent Automation & Soft Computing|language=en|volume=13|issue=4|pages=429–445|doi=10.1080/10798587.2007.10642974 |doi-broken-date=1 July 2025 |url-access=subscription}}</ref>

He chaired the International Symposium on Signal Processing and its applications (ISSPA) 2007 conference organized by [[University of Jijel]], and was also the chair/co-chair of the program committee of several conferences.<ref>{{cite journal |doi=10.1109/MSP.2006.1657824 |title=ISSPA 2007 - Call for Papers |journal=IEEE Signal Processing Magazine |year=2006 |volume=23 |issue=4 |page=123 |bibcode=2006ISPM...23..123. }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://dese.org.uk/dese2020-committees-2/|title=DeSE2020 Committees – DeSE – Developments in E-Systems Engineering|website=dese.org.uk}}</ref>

He was Deputy Editor-in-Chief of the International Journal of Modeling, Identification and Control, is currently the Head of the Intelligent Systems Research Group at the University of Sharjah where he also led the strategic planning development of the research.<ref>{{Cite web|title=International Journal of Modelling, Identification and Control (IJMIC) Inderscience Publishers - linking academia, business and industry through research|url=https://www.inderscience.com/info/inarticletoc.php?jcode=ijmic&year=2015&vol=24&issue=4|access-date=2021-06-02|website=www.inderscience.com|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://icerega.utbm.fr/plenary-and-opening/|title=Plenary and Opening {{pipe}} ICEREGA 2021 {{pipe}} ICEREGA 2020 (UTBM)|website=icerega.utbm.fr|date=28 February 2016 }}</ref>

==Awards==
Professor Bettayeb has received several awards and honors during his career in recognition of his work, including:<ref>{{Cite web|title=Topic 1 : Renewable Energy|url=https://algerianamericanfoundation.org/files/2019/p9a15_AAFSU2019_G1_Bios_9juin.pdf|access-date=June 2, 2021|website=algerianamericanfoundation.org}}</ref>
* Prize for the best research distinguished in 1993-94 and 1998–99 at [[King Fahd University of Petroleum and Minerals]] (KFUPM).
* Outstanding adviser award in 1996–97 at KFUPM.{{citation needed|date=July 2021}}
* Award for the best researcher at the [[University of Sharjah]] (UoS) in 2001–2002, 2006–2007, 2007–2008 and 2010–2011.
* [[Sharjah Islamic Bank]]'s Best Research Paper Award in 2003–2004.
* Prize for the best research project in 2006–2007 at UoS.
* Supervisor of the award for best student article, supervisor of the award for best student project in 2006–2007 at UOS.
* Director of the prize for the best master's thesis in 2009–2010 at UoS.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://gulfnews.com/uae/education/win-a-research-award-1.277840|title=Win a research award|website=gulfnews.com|date=19 February 2005 }}</ref>
* Award for the best teaching at the University of Sharjah in 2011–2012.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://region8today.ieeer8.org/events/ieee-ss12-age-of-innovation-competition-in-university-of-sharjah/|title=IEEE Region 8 Today - IEEE SS12: Age of Innovation Competition in University of Sharjah|date=July 8, 2018}}</ref>
* IEOM Distinguished Leadership Award in 2020.<ref>{{Cite web|title=2020 IEOM Awards – 10th Annual Conference|url=https://www.ieomsociety.org/awards-dubai2020.pdf|access-date=June 2, 2021|website=www.ieomsociety.org}}</ref>
